needLogin: Sign in to calendar share under Account → Identity before adding subscriptions.

filter.title: Subscriptions
filter.loggedOut: Sign in to calendar share to use the subscription filter. Local sources still work.
filter.offline: Calendar share is unreachable. Subscriptions stay disabled until it reconnects. Local sources still work.

mine.title: Subscribed calendars
mine.help: Removing a calendar unsubscribes it on the calendar server. Timeline visibility still uses the source filter.

search.title: Search public calendars
search.help: Search public busy/details calendars, or paste handle/slug. Calendars granted only to you appear after you sign in.
search.pathHelp: Paste handle/slug, e.g. DemoPub/Open. You cannot subscribe to the handle you publish as.
search.rejectOwn: You cannot subscribe to your own calendar.
